description:
Album-first music library for local audio and Spotify

Retune combines local audio files and a Spotify library in one album-first
desktop music library while keeping personal metadata local.
Retune 0.3.25 for macOS Apple Silicon, Windows x64/ARM64, and Ubuntu/Arch Linux amd64/arm64.
macOS is stable-signed with the Open CLI Collective self-signed certificate but is not Apple-notarized.
Windows application payloads and NSIS installers are unsigned.
